note: Who may approve and publish a rule version or a fee schedule version. Set approval_policy to single or independent. The environment variable ACME_APPROVAL_POLICY overrides this value for one run.

values.single: One City Administrator may take a version from draft to published, including the author, with a confirmation and a reason recorded.
values.independent: The author of a version may not approve or publish it. A different administrator must do both.
